law_name: Flash mission on income continuity for artist-authors (mission flash sur la continuité de revenus des artistes-auteurs)
description: Served as rapporteur of the joint (Social Affairs / Cultural Affairs) flash mission examining how to establish income continuity for artist-authors (June-November 2025).
significance: A parliamentary fact-finding role rather than enacted legislation; reflects her focus on social-protection issues during her 2025 mandate.

law_name: Flash mission on European experiences with low-emission zones (zones à faibles émissions)
description: Co-rapporteur of a flash mission comparing European experiences with low-emission mobility zones (May-August 2021) during her 2020-2022 mandate.
significance: A comparative parliamentary mission rather than a law; relates to air-quality and urban-mobility policy.

law_name: Co-signed bills (égalité dans l'attribution du nom, réduction de l'exposition à la pollution de l'air, lutte contre les contenus terroristes en ligne)
description: Co-signed several legislative proposals during her 2020-2022 mandate, including measures on equality in the attribution and choice of family name, reducing population exposure to air pollution, and adapting EU rules on the prevention of online terrorist content.
significance: Co-sponsorship rather than primary authorship; indicates her thematic interests in civil/family law and the environment. National legislative footprint is relatively modest.
